FN-5CBL66-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 77
Committee: Ways and Means - Education Sponsor: Representative Danny Garrett
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/20/2023
House Bill 77 as introduced increases the threshold for submitting estimated monthly sales tax
payments from $5,000 in state sales tax liability, currently, to $20,000, which would remove an
estimated 3,100 sales tax licensees from the requirement of making monthly estimated
payments. Raising this threshold will reduce sales tax receipts held in escrow by an estimated
$15.2 million in the month of October 2023; however this reduction will be offset by the
eventual collection of actual sales tax receipts.
